name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: A soft stage spotlight searches the dark, overshoots, lands on the logo, and the house lights come up. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .sp-logo element.
useWhen: A launch, keynote or event video should open with a theatrical reveal, the logo waiting in the dark until the light finds it.
You want a slower, confident reveal with an obvious landing beat around 0.9 s.
avoidWhen: The light should be a horizontal lens streak with a cinematic film feel: use anamorphic-flare.
The reveal needs energy and an impact hit rather than a search: use orbit-lock.
author: Remocn
